comment: Our pad entities placed in the world by pad_sector.py (docs/helipads.md, step 8). sector: our sector that holds them (a second sector of our own with its own descriptor did not load, so they share this one). base_box: the descriptor box the sector's other nodes need (the Watson car spawners). pads: one per visual-only pad, the part entities (pad_entity.py, one per 100 meshes) at the proxy's transform; streaming_distance as far as the hidden proxy drew (its forcedAutoHideDistance); node_id: globalNodeId of the first part, the next ones count up. spawners: vehicle spawners (pad_sector.py), a fresh car on every load.

pads.note: the inventor's hangar (docs/helipads.md section 9; tools/heightmap/hangar_build.py), on bare salt flat in the Badlands; z is the floor origin, terrain 58.21 .. 58.46 under it
